title: Art round 3: weapons back, new enemies

cards.title: Art round 3
cards.text: Your picks with the new weapon rule, the Bastions and Warhelm redone, and the new enemies. Tick the keepers.
cards.why: Each tick becomes a unit in the game. Each picture shows the design beside the archer at the same size, then 8 turns at game size.
cards.details:
Weapons now sit behind the body and shoulder and come out forward, with only the fist showing, as you asked for the Paladin. Shields stay in front.

The sprite box is the limit: with the weapon starting under the body, there's only a little room in front, so the longest weapons run diagonally to stay big.

Where a note was open there are two versions: Wildmane with or without the scar, Shade's daggers spread or crossed, the banshee hooded or with hair, the lizardman with a spear or a blade.

items.label: Knight · Paladin
items.text:
Your note: Weapons more forward, behind the body/shoulder. Shield is the special case.

Changed: Sword under the right shoulder, only the fist showing; shield stays in front.

Still weak: The sword angles a little outward.

items.label: Knight · Old Guard
items.text:
Your note: (Picked.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Greatsword runs long and diagonal under the beard.

Still weak: Diagonal so it fits the sprite: longer, but less straight ahead.

items.label: Knight · Dame
items.text:
Your note: (Picked, tiara.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Leaf sword under the left shoulder; guard less hooked.

Still weak: Small sword next to the shield.

items.label: Knight · Bastion, Tower
items.text:
Your note: No eye holes.

Changed: A smooth closed helm, no slit at all. Bigger dark-iron mace.

Still weak: The least person-like; the mace is small.

items.label: Knight · Bastion, Bulwark
items.text:
Your note: Looks like a paint brush.

Changed: A thin winged spear with a sharp kite head; the butt shows behind the shoulder.

Still weak: Spear shows short in front.

items.label: Knight · Bastion, Griffon
items.text:
Your note: Almost good. Helmet boring.

Changed: Big gold feathered wings, a purple crest and a gold beak over the face. Clear block-head hammer.

Still weak: Busiest knight; crest stripe like the others.

items.label: Barbarian · Wildmane
items.text:
Your note: Bigger weapon.

Changed: Broadsword much bigger, diagonal under the beard.

Still weak: Points across more than ahead.

items.label: Barbarian · Wildmane (scar)
items.text:
Your note: Add scar on 'eye'?

Changed: The same, with a short pale scar where the left eye would be.

Still weak: The scar is a fleck at game size.

items.label: Barbarian · Bearskin
items.text:
Your note: (Picked, club.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Pale spiked club under the right paw.

Still weak: Paw hides the handle: can read as a drumstick. The round-2 axe is the fallback.

items.label: Barbarian · Warhelm
items.text:
Your note: A and B as one. Beard doesn't cover the face. Pads too detailed. Longer handle. No spikes.

Changed: One Warhelm: plain domed pads, no spikes; the beard covers everything below the cheeks, with a moustache; longer haft, bigger head.

Still weak: Hammer still mostly hidden.

items.label: Barbarian · Berserker
items.text:
Your note: Spikes on the top face of the mace.

Changed: Five spikes on top of the ball as well as round the rim; bigger ball, one more chain link.

Still weak: Top spikes are a glint at game size.

items.label: Rogue · Twinfang
items.text:
Your note: Weapons forward, behind the shoulders, further apart.

Changed: Daggers behind the shoulders, fists at the front corners, further apart, angled out.

Still weak: Daggers a little shorter so they fit.

items.label: Rogue · Bandit
items.text:
Your note: (Picked, mask.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Slimmer cutlass coming out under the right of the mantle.

Still weak: Couldn't get the blade longer and stay in the sprite.

items.label: Rogue · Shade (spread)
items.text:
Your note: (Picked, cape.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Curved daggers spread apart.

Still weak: Close to Twinfang now.

items.label: Rogue · Shade (crossed)
items.text:
Your note: (Picked, cape.)

Changed: The rule, but the daggers keep Shade's crossed X ahead of the chin.

Still weak: Hands still near the chin.

items.label: Farmer · Granny Reaper
items.text:
Your note: Weapon too small. Specifically handle.

Changed: Handle about 1.5x longer, held in two fists under the shoulder; blade wider.

Still weak: The handle end at the shoulder is the closest to 'over the shoulder'.

items.label: Farmer · Haymaker
items.text:
Your note: Handle short. Hat too detailed, bowl not wide enough. Tines too shiny.

Changed: Handle 1.6x longer; a plain hat with a wider crown and a red band; matte tines.

Still weak: The fork points off at an angle.

items.label: Farmer · Digger
items.text:
Your note: Longer handle, below body.

Changed: Handle twice as long, under the body; spade forward.

Still weak: Spade angles off to the right.

items.label: Farmer · Grandpa Sickle
items.text:
Your note: (Picked.)

Changed: Weapon further forward, behind the shoulder. Sickle a bit bigger, clear of the beard.

Still weak: Free hand still over the body.

items.label: Skeleton · Rattler
items.text:
Your note: No rib cage, or pull it back. Overall good.

Changed: Nothing left in front of the skull; sword behind the shoulder, a bit wider.

Still weak: The empty hand floats under the shoulder.

items.label: Skeleton · Rattler, bow
items.text:
Your note: Give a bow or spear.

Changed: A recurve bow held out in front, arrow and drawing claw; the string can pull back like the archer's.

Still weak: Ring-shaped like the archer at game size.

items.label: Skeleton · Rattler, spear
items.text:
Your note: Give a bow or spear.

Changed: A long thin spear with a leaf head (not a brush); butt behind the shoulder.

Still weak: Spear on one side only.

items.label: Skeleton · Rattler, mace
items.text:
Your note: Give him a mace.

Changed: A rusty spiked mace on a handle under the shoulder.

items.label: Skeleton · Gaper
items.text:
Your note: 2 long swords. A bit angry.

Changed: Two long thin swords angled out; sockets slanting down to the nose with a brow ridge.

Still weak: Claws sit back by the cheeks so the swords fit.

items.label: Skeleton · Brute
items.text:
Your note: Give shield. Can't tell what the weapon is.

Changed: Round wooden shield in front, claw hidden; a big bearded axe instead of the cleaver.

items.label: Banshee (hood)
items.text:
Your note: Keep the Hollow's head for a ghoul/banshee.

Changed: The Hollow's skull in a ragged hood, a ghost body trailing into wisps, bony hands reaching forward.

Still weak: Skull is still warm bone; glowing eyes would be an option.

items.label: Banshee (hair)
items.text:
Your note: Same.

Changed: The same with long lavender-white hair instead of the hood.

Still weak: Hair and body blur together small.

items.label: Slime
items.text:
Your note: Get me the slimes in here.

Changed: A jelly blob with a shine, a bone and a coin inside, eyes at the front.

items.label: Slime, small
items.text: Changed: What it splits into: smaller, paler, bigger eyes.

items.label: Fire slime
items.text: Changed: A molten slime with flames off its back that can flicker. Built for burn.

items.label: Bat
items.text:
Your note: Bats.

Changed: Small, wings spread so they can flap.

items.label: Ghost
items.text:
Your note: Ghosts.

Changed: A plain sheet ghost, unlike the banshee.

items.label: Lizardman (spear)
items.text:
Your note: Lizard men.

Changed: Snout forward, crest, tail behind; a leaf spear under the shoulder.

Still weak: Olive green, near the archer's green.

items.label: Lizardman (blade)
items.text:
Changed: The same with a curved scimitar.

Still weak: The scimitar can read as a tusk.

items.label: Spider
items.text:
Your note: Spiders.

Changed: Round marked body, six red eyes, eight legs that can move.

items.label: Snowman
items.text:
Your note: Snowmen.

Changed: Bucket hat, red scarf, carrot nose forward, stick arms.

Still weak: The two balls blur below the scarf.

items.label: Mimic (artist's idea)
items.text:
Your note: (You said yes to mimic chests.)

Changed: A chest whose lid is a mouth of teeth, tongue out.
